user.title: ISYGLT Main Controller
user.description: Connect to the ISYGLT Modbus TCP controller.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Modbus TCP controller.

abort.already_configured: This Modbus TCP controller is already configured.

add_light.title: Add Light
add_light.description: Choose Dimmable or Switched. Dimmable automatically uses an ISYGLT M address (holding register); Switched automatically uses an NE address (coil). Modbus addressing is calculated internally.

add_switch.title: Add Switch
add_switch.description: Switch using a native ISYGLT NE address. For example, enter 12.4 for NE 12.4. The Modbus coil and protocol offset are calculated automatically.

add_cover.title: Add Cover
add_cover.description: Cover with two native ISYGLT NE addresses. Open and close send a 3-second long press. Stop sends a 200 ms short press on the same direction. Two short-press Button entities are also created.

add_climate.title: Add Climate
add_climate.description: Temperature controller with current temperature and target registers. Scale 10 means for example 215 = 21.5 °C.

error.invalid_isyglt_address: Invalid ISYGLT address. For Dimmable use for example 8 (M 8); for Switched use for example 30.3 (NE 30.3).
error.invalid_switch_address: Invalid Switch address. Use an NE group.bit address such as 1.1 or 30.3.
error.invalid_cover_address: Invalid Cover address. Use an NE group.bit address such as 20.1.
error.cover_addresses_equal: Up and down must use different NE addresses.
